title: The Target Endcap and the Sampler
lessons: The player sees AG1 on a large Target endcap, scoop and shaker propped in front, instead of encountering it only through the brand's website.
The player already drinks AG1 and opens a sampler with Berry, Citrus, and Tropical after getting tired of always using Original.

text: Target. End of the household aisle. AG1 has a whole endcap, scoop and shaker propped up in front like a display kitchen.

entry-first-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: Huh. You look weirdly normal in Target.

entry-first-2.speaker: AG1
text: I've been working on normal. Same shelf, same aisle, whenever you happen to walk by.

entry-first-3.speaker: PLAYER
text: The scoop and the shaker are doing a lot of talking for you.

choice-first.speaker: AG1
text: They're less pushy than the podcast ads. What's the shelf telling you?

choices.text: One glass instead of a handful of pills. Okay, that got me.
Does it actually replace the pills, or does it just feel like it does?
I don't need a whole supplement ritual on top of a grocery run.

first-1.speaker: AG1
text: Then let it be one glass. I'm not going to ask for more than that today.

first-2.speaker: AG1
text: Depends on the pills. If a doctor put you on something, I'm not that. I'm the stuff you'd probably skip otherwise, in one scoop. Ask them, not the endcap.

first-3.speaker: AG1
text: Then keep walking. At least I only cost you one aisle.
Your kitchen, but you bought the sampler at Target: Berry, Citrus, Tropical. Original is still open on the counter.

entry-return-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: I cheated on Original.

entry-return-2.speaker: AG1
text: With Berry?

entry-return-3.speaker: PLAYER
text: Don't sound pleased. I was bored.

entry-return-4.speaker: AG1
text: That's why the other three exist. Same scoop, same everything, different fruit.

entry-return-5.speaker: PLAYER
text: So you made new flavors because people were getting bored of you.

entry-return-6.speaker: AG1
text: Some people. The same green glass at the same time every morning wears on some people. I'm told.

choice-return.speaker: AG1
text: Well?

choices.text: Honestly, I like switching it up.
So people really were getting sick of Original.

return-1.speaker: AG1
text: Good. Then rotate. Just don't tell Original.

return-2.speaker: AG1
text: Some. Yes.

return-2-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: Thank you.

return-2-2.speaker: AG1
text: I wasn't fighting you on it.

return-3.speaker: AG1
text: I know. Berry doesn't make the pouch cheaper. I wasn't going to say it did.
